answer_1.quote: We propose an emotional support response generation scheme, named Emotion-focused and Strategy-driven Chain-of-Thought (ESCoT), to generate dialogue data... We build an emotional support dialogue system with better interpretability via supervised fine-tuning a pre-trained language model on ESD-CoT...
answer_1.outputs: Emotional support response with accompanying chain-of-thought reasoning (quintuple EM, ES, IA, SR, RE)

answer_2.quote: We apply three commonly used automatic evaluation metrics, BLEU-n , ROUGE-L ; and Distinct-n .

answer_4.quote: we recruit 3 professional annotators to evaluate randomly selected 50 responses of different settings from the Coherence, Informativeness, and Empathy aspects with the levels of {0,1,2}. We also conduct a human evaluation to evaluate the Accuracy of the consistency between the selected strategy and the corresponding response.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each response on Coherence, Informativeness, Empathy, and Strategy Consistency using a 0‑2 scale.
